harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «الذي»: a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. The clause «ولم يجعل» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause), and the preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «قيما»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {لَهُ}. The genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لينذر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {أَنْزَلَ}. «لدنه» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive, attached to a second naʿt (adjective) of «بأسا». The interpreted maṣdar «أن لهم أجرا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «ماكثين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {لَهُمْ}; the preposition and its genitive noun and the adverb are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ماكثين.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «وينذر» is conjoined to the clause «يبشر».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: His words «ما لهم به من علم»: «ما» is negating and inoperative; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «علم»; «علم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «به» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «علم». «كلمة» is a tamyīz (specification); «إن» is negating; the two clauses «كبرت» and «إن يقولون» are resumptive; «كذبا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «فلعلك باخع» is resumptive; «نفسك» is the object of «باخع», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «باخع». The clause «إن لم يؤمنوا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «الحديث» is a badal (substitute). «أسفا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The preposition «على الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); «زينة» is a second object; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لنبلوهم» is attached to «جعلنا». «أيهم» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), «أحسن» is the khabar (predicate), and «عملا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «أيهم أحسن» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «نبلو», which is suspended (muʿallaq) because it is a cause of knowledge; it is in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «وإنا لجاعلون» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا}. «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «عليها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); «صعيدا» is the second object of the active participle «جاعلون»; «جرزا» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: أم is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of بل and the hamza, and the clause is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of حسب. The preposition «من آياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عجبا».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) {عَجَبًا}, and the clause «أوى» is muḍāf ilayhi. «آتنا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the pronoun «نا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «من لدنك» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «رحمة»; the preposition «من أمرنا» is attached to a ḥāl of «رشدا», the object.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The two preposition and its genitive nouns «على آذانهم» and «في الكهف» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «سنين» is an adverb attached to «ضربنا»; «عددا» is a naʿt (adjective) in the sense of معدودة (counted), and it is of the pattern faʿal in the sense of mafʿūl (passive participle).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «أيّ»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أحصى» is a past verb; the clause stands in place of the two objects of «علم», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; the clause «أحصى» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «أيُّ». The lām in «لما» is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أمدًا»; the implied form is: أحصى أمدا كائنا للبثهم (counted a term, being for their stay). Taking «أحصى» as a verb is preferred over [taking it as] an elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl), because forming the elative on afʿal from what is more than three letters is rare.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object; the clause «آمنوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «فتية»; «هدى» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وربطنا» is conjoined to the clause «زدناهم»; «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ربطنا», and the clause «قاموا» is muḍāf ilayhi. The preposition «من دونه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إلها»; «إذًا» is a particle of answer; «شططا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: [a] saying. The clause «لقد قلنا» is the apodosis of an implied oath, and the oath with its apodosis is a resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «قومنا»: a badal (substitute), and the clause «اتخذوا» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; «آلهة» is the first object. «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the clause «يأتون» is resumptive; the preposition «عليهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سلطان». The clause «فمن أظلم» is resumptive, and it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the preposition «ممن» is attached to «أظلم», and the preposition «على الله» is attached to «افترى».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «وإذ اعتزلتموهم» is resumptive, and the clause «اعتزلتموهم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: some of them said to others at the time of their withdrawal. «اعتزلتموهم» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the wāw is for prolongation (ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «اعتزلتموهم»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the Name of Majesty is the object of the verb. The clause «فأووا» is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن اعتزلتموهم فأووا (if you have withdrawn from them, then take refuge). His words «ينشر»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of an implied condition. The preposition «من أمركم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مرفقا».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The first conditional clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشمس»; the clause «طلعت» is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause «تزاور» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «ذات» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «وهم في فجوة منه» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ in «تقرضهم», and the preposition «منه» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «فجوة». The clause «ذلك من آيات الله» is resumptive. «مَن» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); [يهد is] an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; «المهتد» is a nominative khabar (predicate), with a ḍamma implied on the dropped yāʾ; the preposition «له» is attached to the second object of «تجد».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «وهم رقود» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in «تحسبهم»; the clause «ونقلبهم» is conjoined to the clause «تحسبهم». The clause «وكلبهم باسط» is conjoined to «نقلبهم», and the conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «فرارا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), synonymous with its governor. The lām in «لملئت» is for strengthening the link; the preposition «منهم» is attached to the verb, and «رعبا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: His words «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: بعثناهم بعثًا مثل ذلك البعث (We raised them with a raising like that raising). The clause «بعثناهم» is resumptive. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of قائل. «كم» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of time, and its tamyīz (specification) is implied, i.e.: كم يوما (how many days). «يوما» is an adverb of time attached to the verb; «بعض» is a noun conjoined to «يوما». «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to أعلم. The preposition «بورقكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أحدكم». «هذه» is a demonstrative noun, a naʿt; it is non-derived (jāmid), interpreted as a derived word, i.e.: المشار إليه (the one pointed to). The clause «فابعثوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فلينظر» is conjoined to the clause «ابعثوا». His words «أيها»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «أزكى» is its khabar (predicate); «طعاما» is a tamyīz; and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and contains the sense of knowing. The fāʾ in «فليأتكم» is a conjunction, the lām is for command; an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; and the preposition «منه» is attached to a naʿt of رزق.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The conditional clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; the preposition «في ملتهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf; and the clause «ولن تفلحوا» is conjoined to the clause «يعيدوكم».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: His words «وكذلك»: the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi; the implied form is: أعثرنا عليهم إعثارا مثل ذلك (We made them come upon them with a making-aware like that). أنَّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of علم. The clause «أعثرنا» is resumptive, and the second maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to the first. «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعثرنا». The clause «فقالوا» is conjoined to the clause «يتنازعون»; «بنيانا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ربهم أعلم» is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate). The clause «لنتخذن» is the apodosis of the oath, and the oath with its apodosis is what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «ثلاثة»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هم (they). The clause «رابعهم كلبهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of ثلاثة. «رجما» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يقولون», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «رجما». The clause «وثامنهم كلبهم» is conjoined to the clause «هم سبعة». The preposition «بعدَّتهم» is attached to the khabar «أعلم». The clause «ما يعلمهم إلا قليل» is resumptive; «قليل» is the fāʿil (agent), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The clause «فلا تمار» is resumptive, and «مراء» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: His words «ولا تقولن»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive; an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and the nūn is for emphasis; [the verb is] in the position of the jussive. «ذلك» is a demonstrative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle; «غدًا» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فاعل».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: His words «إلا أن يشاء الله»: «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ, i.e.: ملتبسًا بمشيئة الله (joined with Allah's will); the exception is emptied (mufarragh). «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اذكر». The maṣdar «أن يهدين» is the fāʿil (agent) of عسى; «يهدين» is an accusative imperfect verb, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «لأقرب» is attached to «يهدين»; the preposition «من هذا» is attached to «أقرب»; «رشدا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «ولبثوا» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and so is the adverb «ثلاث»; «مائة» is muḍāf ilayhi; «سنين» is a badal (substitute) of «ثلاث مائة», accusative with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; «تسعا» is a tamyīz (specification). His words «وازدادوا»: if this verb is on the pattern iftaʿala it becomes intransitive, and if it is on the pattern faʿala it is transitive to two [objects], as in: «زدني علما» (increase me in knowledge).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «بما لبثوا»: the bāʾ is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم», and the clause «لبثوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative. The clause «له غيب السماوات» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and so is the clause «أبصر به». His words «أبصر»: a past verb that came in the form of the imperative; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the hāʾ is a pronoun, the fāʿil (agent); likewise «أسمع», and the fāʿil of the second was omitted because the fāʿil of the first indicates it. His words «ما لهم من دونه»: «ما» is negating and inoperative; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ولي», and «من» is redundant; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ولي»; and the clause is resumptive. The clause «ولا يشرك» is conjoined to the clause «ما لهم ولي».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «من كتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; the clause «لا مبدِّل لكلماته» is a ḥāl of «كتاب»; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, operating like «إنّ», [followed by] its noun. The clause «ولن تجد» is conjoined to «لا مبدِّل»; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to the second object of «وجد», and «ملتحدا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «مع»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «يريدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يدعون»; «عيناك» is a fāʿil, nominative with the alif because it is dual; and the clause «تريد» is a ḥāl of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «تَعْدُ».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The preposition «من ربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الحق», and the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «الحق من ربكم». «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ, and the lām in «فليؤمن» is the jussive lām of command. The clause «إنا أعتدنا» is resumptive; the clause «أحاط بهم سرادقها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نارا»; the preposition «كالمهل» is attached to a naʿt of ماء. The clause «يشوي» is a second naʿt; the clause «بئس الشراب» is resumptive, and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being هو, i.e.: the water. «ساءت» is a past verb of blame, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هي, i.e.: the Fire; «مرتفقا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «إنَّا لا نضيع» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the linking pronoun is implied, i.e.: منهم (of them). «مَن» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; «عملا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «لهم جنات» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك». The clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective) of جنات; the clause «يحلَّون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «لهم»; and the clause «نعم الثواب» is resumptive. The preposition «من ذهب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of أساور; «متكئين» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يلبسون», and the two preposition and its genitive nouns are attached to «متكئين». His words «مرتفقا»: a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «رجلين»: a badal (substitute), and the clause «جعلنا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجلين»; the preposition «لأحدهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The preposition «من أعناب» is attached to a naʿt of «جنتين», and the adverb «بينهما» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «كلتا»: a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with a ḍamma implied on the alif because [pronouncing it] is impossible; the more eloquent usage for the khabar (predicate) of «كلتا» is the singular. The clause «آتت» is the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «وكان له ثمر» is resumptive; the clause «وهو يحاوره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «قال»; the preposition «منك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) أكثر. «مالا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «وهو ظالم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «دخل». «لنفسه»: the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening; «نفسه» is the object of ظالم. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تبيد» stands in place of the two objects of ظن, and «أبدًا» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «ولئن رددت» is conjoined to the clause «وما أظن»; the clause «لأجدنَّ» is the apodosis of the oath, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا»; «منقلبا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «وهو يحاوره» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «صاحبه»; «ثم» is a conjunction; the preposition «من نطفة» is conjoined to «من تراب» and is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to; «رجلا» is a ḥāl of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His words «لكنَّا هو الله ربي»: this clause is resumptive within the scope of the preceding saying. «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), lightened and inoperative; «أنا» is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose hamza was dropped for lightening, the original being لكن أنا; «هو» is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), a second mubtadaʾ; «الله» is a third mubtadaʾ; «ربي» is the khabar (predicate) of the third mubtadaʾ. The clause «هو الله ربي» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أنا», and the clause «الله ربي» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هو». The clause «ولا أشرك» is conjoined to the clause «الله ربي».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); the clause «دخلت» is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «ولولا قلت» is conjoined to the preceding resumptive [clause] that came within the scope of the saying, the conjunction coming before «لولا». «ما»: conditional, a fronted object, and the apodosis is implied, i.e.: whatever Allah wills is and takes place. The clause «ما شاء الله كان» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «لا قوة إلا بالله» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. His words «إن ترن»: «إن» is conditional; an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "you" (أنت). «أنا» is a pronoun emphasising the yāʾ, with no grammatical position; «أقلَّ» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقل»; «مالا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «إن ترن» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is in the following verse.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «فعسى ربي» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤتين» is the khabar (predicate) of «عسى»; «يؤتين» is an accusative imperfect verb, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «خيرا» is a second mafʿūl bihi; the preposition «من جنتك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «طلبا».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وهي خاوية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «فيها»; the preposition «على عروشها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خاوية»; «يا» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ينصرونه» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and the clause «وما كان» is conjoined to the clause «لم تكن».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: His words «هنالك»: a demonstrative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الولاية»; the preposition «لله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الولاية»; «الحق» is a naʿt (adjective); «ثوابا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The preposition «ماء» [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase in the verse is «كماء»] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: هو كماء; and the clause «هي كماء» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مثل الحياة الدنيا». The clause «تذروه الرياح» is a naʿt (adjective) of «هشيما».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير»; «ثوابا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the object of an implied اذكر (remember), and the clause «اذكر» is resumptive. The clause «نُسَيِّر» is muḍāf ilayhi; «بارزة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «وحشرناهم» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «نسيِّر», i.e.: We carry out the setting in motion in the state of Our gathering them. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «أحدا».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وعرضوا» is conjoined to the clause {نُسَيِّرُ}; the clause «لقد جئتمونا» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is what is said (maqūl al-qawl) by an omitted saying, which is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nominative [pronoun] of «عُرضوا», i.e.: they were presented, it being said to them. «كما»: the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), «ما» is maṣdariyya; «أول» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, being an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun); the implied form is: جئتمونا مجيئًا مثل خلقكم خلقا أول مرة (you have come to Us with a coming like Our creating you, a creating the first time). The clause «زعمتم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «أنْ» is lightened from the heavy [أنّ], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «لن نجعل» is the khabar (predicate) of the lightened «أن»; the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «مشفقين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of المجرمين; the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشفقين»; the preposition «فيه» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «ويقولون» is conjoined to the single word «مشفقين». «يا ويلتنا»: one addressed in the vocative, in construct, accusative, and the pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi. «ما لهذا الكتاب»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate); «الكتاب» is a badal (substitute); and the clause is the response to the vocative, which conveys lamentation. The clause «لا يغادر» is a ḥāl of «الكتاب». The clause «أحصاها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صغيرة»; the clause «ووجدوا» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يقولون»; «حاضرا» is a second object. The clause «ولا يَظْلم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: (وإذ قلنا للملائكة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, the object of an implied اذكر (remember). The clause «كان» is resumptive. The interrogative clause is resumptive; «ذريته» is a noun conjoined to the hāʾ; «أولياء» is a second object; the preposition «من دوني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولياء. The clause «وهم لكم عدو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ and the offspring; the preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «عدو». «بدلا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the clause of blame is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «عضدا»: the second object of «متخذ», and its first object is «المضلين» in position.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied اذكر (remember). The two objects of «زعمتم» are omitted, i.e.: زعمتموهم شركائي (you claimed them to be My partners). The clause «وجعلنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يستجيبوا». His words «بينهم»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object, and «موبقا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أَنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ظن; the preposition «عنها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «وجد».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The two preposition and its genitive nouns: «للناس», [and] the preposition «من كل», are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرَّفْنا». The clause «وكان الإنسان أكثر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤمنوا» is the second object of «منع», as in: منعته النوم (I kept him from sleep); the verb «منع» is transitive by itself to two objects, or to the second object with «مِنْ». «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منع», and the clause «جاءهم» is muḍāf ilayhi. «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the maṣdar «أن تأتيهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «منع»; «قبلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «العذاب».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «مبشرين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المرسلين»; the clause «ويجادل» is resumptive, and the clause «واتخذوا» is circumstantial. His words «وما أنذروا»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is conjoined to «آياتي»; «هزوا» is the second object of «اتخذوا».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: His words «ومن أظلم»: the wāw is resumptive; «مَن» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), [followed by] its khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition «على قلوبهم» is attached to the second object of «جعلنا»; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يفقهوه» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: كراهة (out of dislike that). His words «في آذانهم وقرا»: the preposition and its genitive noun is conjoined to «على قلوبهم», and «وقرا» is a noun conjoined to «أكنة». The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «إنا جعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «ذو»: a second khabar (predicate); the conditional clause is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ربك». The clause «لهم موعد» is resumptive; the clause «لن يجدوا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «موعد»; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «القرى»: a badal (substitute), and the clause «أهلكناهم» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «لمَّا ظلموا» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: لمَّا ظلموا أهلكناهم (when they did wrong, We destroyed them). The clause «تلك القرى» is conjoined to the clause «ربك الغفور».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: (وإذ قال موسى لفتاه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied اذكر (remember). «أبرح» is an imperfect verb in the sense of أغادر (I leave off). «حقبا» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أمضي».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «فلما بلغا» is conjoined to the implied clause اذكر; «بينهما» is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with kasra; the clause «نسيا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «سَرَبا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «لقد لقينا» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «هذا» is a demonstrative noun, naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «أرأيت» is in the sense of أخبرني (tell me), and its two objects are omitted, i.e.: أرأيت أمرنا ما عاقبته؟ (have you seen our affair — what is its outcome?). «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (عاقبته). The clause «فإني نسيت» is resumptive. His words «وما أنسانيه»: the wāw is parenthetical; «ما» is negating; a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied because [pronouncing it] is impossible; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is the second object; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أذكره» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from the hāʾ, i.e.: أنساني ذكره (made me forget mentioning it). The clause «اتخذ» is conjoined to the clause «إني نسيت». «عجبا» is a second object; the preposition «في البحر» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عجبا».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ما»: a relative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «ذلك». «نَبْغِ» is an imperfect verb, nominative with a ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, which was dropped in the script for lightening. The clause «فارتدا» is conjoined to the resumptive «قال». «قصصا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: قاصِّين (retracing).

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The preposition «من عبادنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عبدا»; the preposition «من عندنا» is attached to a naʿt of رحمة.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: His words «على أن تُعَلّمن»: «على» is a preposition; «أنْ» makes [the verb] accusative; an imperfect verb, accusative with fatḥa; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «ممَّا»: composed of the preposition «مِن» and the relative «ما», in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf, i.e.: كائنا على تعليمي (being [committed] to teaching me). «رشدا» is the second object of «تعلِّمنِ».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: His words «وكيف»: the wāw is a conjunction; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial); «خبرا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is in the sense of the verb, since it has the force of «لم يخبره خبرا» (he did not come to know it by knowing). The clause «وكيف تصبر» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «ولا أعصي» is conjoined to the single word «صابرا», as a case of conjoining a clause to a single word.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The fāʾ in His words «فإن» is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: إن عزمت على الصبر (if you are resolved on patience); the clause «إن عزمت» is what is said (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «إن اتبعتني» is the apodosis of the implied condition, and the clause «فلا تسألني» is the apodosis of the second condition. The preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ذكرا».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). The clause «لقد جئت» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «معي»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) in «تستطيع».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the preposition «من أمري» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عسرا». «عُسْرًا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «فقتله» is conjoined to the clause «لقيا»; the clause «قال» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قتلت»; the clause «لقد جئت» is the apodosis of the oath, and the clause of the oath with its apodosis is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The adverb «معي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) in «تستطيع».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The adverb «بعدها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «سألتك». «لدن» is an adverbial noun in the position of the genitive, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, attached to «بلغت»; the second nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عذرا». The clause «قد بلغت» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «استطعما» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يُضَيّفوهما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يريد» is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اتخذ».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «بيني» is muḍāf ilayhi; «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «سأنبئك» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl), and the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); the clause «كانت» is the khabar (predicate); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أعيبها» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وكان وراءهم ملك» is conjoined to the clause «فكانت لمساكين». The clause «يأخذ» is a naʿt (adjective); «غصبا» is a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The clause «فكان أبواه مؤمنين» is the khabar (predicate) of «الغلام». The masculine was given precedence in His words «أبواه», meaning his father and his mother; similar to it are: القمران (the two moons, i.e. sun and moon) and العُمَران (the two ʿUmars). The clause «فخشينا» is conjoined to the clause «كان أبواه»; «طغيانا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «فأردنا» is conjoined to the clause «خشينا». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبدلهما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «خيرًا» is a second object; the preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خيرًا»; «زكاة» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: The clause «فكان لغلامين» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الجدار». The clause «فأراد ربك» is conjoined to the clause «كان لغلامين». The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يبلغا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «رحمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. The clause «وما فعلته» is resumptive, and the preposition «عن أمري» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ. The clause «ذلك تأويل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «ويسألونك» is resumptive. The preposition «منه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ذكرًا», the object.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The two preposition and its genitive nouns «له» and «في الأرض» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition «من كل» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سببا».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The clause «فأتبع» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا}.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «وجدها» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the adverb «عندها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «وجد». The clause «قلنا» is resumptive. His words «إما أن تعذب»: [إما is] a particle of choice, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: choose: either your punishing them or your taking; the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first. The two objects of «تتخذ» are «حسنًا» and what the preposition «فيهم» is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «مَن»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ in His words «فسوف نعذبه» is connective (rābiṭa) for the apodosis, and the clause «سوف نعذبه» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مَن». «عذابًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being: تعذيب.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «صالحًا»: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «فله جزاء الحسنى»: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «جزاءً» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted governor, its implied form being: يجزي جزاء; «الحسنى» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «يسرا» is the mafʿūl bihi. The preposition «من أمرنا» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يسرا».

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «ثم أتبع» is conjoined to its counterpart in verse (85).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya). The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; the preposition «من دونها» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «سترا».

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: His words «كذلك»: the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive, [the phrase being] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: الأمر كذلك (the matter is thus). The wāw in «وقد» is resumptive; «لديه» is an adverb attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause); «خُبْرًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: أخبرنا خبرا. The clause «وقد أحطنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition «من دونهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قومًا»; the clause «لا يكادون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قومًا; and the clause «يفقهون» is the khabar (predicate) of كاد.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «فهل نجعل» is conjoined to the response to the vocative. The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تجعل» is genitive, attached to «نجعل»; «بيننا» is an adverb of place attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: His words «ما مَكَّنِّي»: «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is «خير». «مكَّنِّي»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a fatḥa implied on the first nūn, its appearance being prevented by the assimilation of the verb's nūn into the nūn of protection (wiqāya). The preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «ربي» is the fāʿil (agent). The clause «فأعينوني» is resumptive, and the clause «أجعل» is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: «آتوني»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the first object; «زُبَر» is the second object. «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the conditional clause is resumptive. The second object of «آتوني» is implied, namely «قطرًا», by way of contention (tanāzuʿ) between «آتوني» and «أفرغ».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يظهروه» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نقبا».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The preposition «من ربي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة; the conditional clause is conjoined to what is said (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause «وكان وعد» is conjoined to the conditional clause.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: His words «يومئذ»: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترك»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn is for compensation. The clause «يموج» is the second object of «ترك». The preposition «في الصور» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: «الذين»: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective); the preposition «عن ذكري» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «غطاء».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The clause «أفحسب» is resumptive; the maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of حسب; the preposition «من دوني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أولياء». The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to a ḥāl of «نزلا».

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: «الذين»: a naʿt (adjective) of الأخسرين; the preposition «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) (سعيهم); the maṣdar «أنهم يحسبون» stands in place of the two objects of حسب; and the clause «وهم يحسبون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The clause «فلا نقيم» is conjoined to the clause «حبطت». «وزنا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «ذلك جزاؤهم»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جزاؤهم».

harrat-mujtaba:107-107.t: The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نزلا».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: «خالدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in {لَهُمْ}; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين; the preposition «عنها» is attached to a ḥāl of «حولا»; and the clause «لا يبغون» is a ḥāl of the pronoun in «لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The preposition «لكلمات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مدادًا», and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنفد» is muḍāf ilayhi. His words «ولو جئنا بمثله مددا»: the wāw is circumstantial; «مددا» is a tamyīz (specification); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; the clause is circumstantial, and the circumstantial wāw is conjoined to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial) for the sake of comprehensiveness; the implied form is: the words of my Lord will not be exhausted in any state, even in this state.

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: «مثلكم»: a naʿt (adjective). Qualifying an indefinite with «مثلكم», though it is in construct, is permitted because it is an indefinite deeply steeped in vagueness that does not gain definiteness from the construct. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «يرجو» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause «فليعمل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
